part1.question: Do you work or are you a student?
What do you like most about your job or your studies?
Where is your hometown, and what is it like?
Has your hometown changed much since you were a child?
Do you live in a house or an apartment?
Which room in your home do you spend the most time in? Why?
What do you usually do in your free time?
How did you spend last weekend?
What kind of food do you like to eat?
Do you prefer eating at home or eating out? Why?
Do you drink more coffee or tea?
Do you enjoy shopping? Why or why not?
What kind of weather do you like best?
How do you usually get to work or school?
How often do you use your mobile phone, and what for?
Do you like reading? What kind of things do you read?
What kind of music do you listen to?
Do you prefer spending time with one friend or with a group of friends?
Do you do any kind of exercise regularly?
Are you a morning person? Why or why not?

part2.question: Describe a skill you learned that you think is very useful.
points: when and how you learned it
and explain why you think it is useful

part2.question: Describe a place you visited that you would like to go back to.
points: when you went there and who you went with
and explain why you would like to go back

part2.question: Describe a person who has helped you in your work or studies.
points: and explain how you felt about their help

part2.question: Describe a difficult decision you made.
points: and explain how you feel about the decision now

part2.question: Describe a café or restaurant you enjoy going to.
points: and explain why you enjoy going there

part2.question: Describe a piece of technology you find difficult to live without.
points: and explain why it is so important to you

part2.question: Describe a goal you would like to achieve in the next few years.
points: what you are doing to achieve it
and explain how you will feel when you achieve it

part2.question: Describe a celebration or event that you remember well.
points: when and where it took place
and explain why you remember it well

part2.question: Describe a book or film that made a strong impression on you.
points: when you read or watched it
and explain why it made a strong impression on you

part2.question: Describe a country you would like to live or work in for a while.
points: and explain why you would like to live or work there
